description: Land Title Settlement Department - Palliyagodella, Medirigiria D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District    - Cad. Map No. 120063
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in Palliyagodella and Nikahena. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership status, and possession details, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
